title: 如果……就 in Chinese: How to Say "If" (HSK 3 Grammar)
description: How to use 如果……就 (rúguǒ... jiù) for "if... then" in Chinese: word order, where 就 goes, 的话, "if I were you", common mistakes and HSK 3 examples.
h1: How to Say "If" with 如果……就
lede: 如果 (rúguǒ) means "if". It starts the condition, and 就 (jiù) often comes in the second part to mean "then". In Chinese the condition almost always comes first.

paras: 如果 can go before or after the subject of the first part: 如果你累了 and 你如果累了 are both fine. 就 goes before the verb in the second part. It isn't always needed, but it makes the link between the two parts clear.

examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。
examples.py: Rúguǒ míngtiān xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù bú qù le.
examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

examples.zh: 如果你有时间，就来我家玩吧。
examples.py: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu shíjiān, jiù lái wǒ jiā wán ba.
examples.en: If you have time, come over to my place.

examples.zh: 你如果累了，就休息一下吧。
examples.py: Nǐ rúguǒ lèi le, jiù xiūxi yíxià ba.
examples.en: If you're tired, have a rest.

paras: If the second part has its own subject, 就 comes after the subject, not before it. Say 我就去, not 就我去. If the second part has no subject, 就 starts it.

examples.zh: 如果你不想去，我就一个人去。
examples.py: Rúguǒ nǐ bù xiǎng qù, wǒ jiù yí ge rén qù.
examples.en: If you don't want to go, I'll go on my own.

examples.zh: 如果他问你，你就说不知道。
examples.py: Rúguǒ tā wèn nǐ, nǐ jiù shuō bù zhīdào.
examples.en: If he asks you, just say you don't know.

examples.zh: 如果你饿了，我们就去吃饭。
examples.py: Rúguǒ nǐ è le, wǒmen jiù qù chīfàn.
examples.en: If you're hungry, let's go and eat.

paras: You can add 的话 at the end of the condition: 如果……的话. It means the same and is very common in speech. With 的话, you can even leave out 如果.
In everyday speech, people often drop 如果 and keep only 就.

examples.zh: 如果有问题的话，就给我打电话。
examples.py: Rúguǒ yǒu wèntí dehuà, jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: If there are any problems, give me a call.

examples.zh: 明天天气好的话，我们就去公园。
examples.py: Míngtiān tiānqì hǎo dehuà, wǒmen jiù qù gōngyuán.
examples.en: If the weather is nice tomorrow, we'll go to the park.

examples.py: Nǐ lèi le jiù xiūxi ba.
examples.en: Have a rest if you're tired.

sections.h2: "If I were you" and 就会
paras: 如果 works for real and imagined situations alike, so 如果我是你 is the way to say "if I were you". To say what will happen as a result, use 就会 + verb.

examples.zh: 如果我是你，我就买这件。
examples.py: Rúguǒ wǒ shì nǐ, wǒ jiù mǎi zhè jiàn.
examples.en: If I were you, I'd buy this one.

examples.zh: 如果你每天练习，你的汉语就会越来越好。
examples.py: Rúguǒ nǐ měi tiān liànxí, nǐ de Hànyǔ jiù huì yuè lái yuè hǎo.
examples.en: If you practise every day, your Chinese will get better and better.

paras: In English the "if" part can come second: "I'll go if you go". In Chinese, put the condition first: 如果你去，我就去.
如果 only means "if", never "when". For something you know will happen, use a time word such as 以后 instead.

examples.zh: 我到家以后就给你打电话。
examples.py: Wǒ dào jiā yǐhòu jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: I'll call you when I get home.

worksheet.title: 如果……就 Worksheet: HSK 3 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 如果……就 worksheet for HSK 3: 19 exercises (如果, 因为 or 虽然, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 如果, 因为 or 虽然
exercises.instructions: Write 如果, 因为 or 虽然 in each gap. Look at the second part of the sentence and the English.

items.zh: ＿＿明天天气不好，我们就在家看电视。
items.en: If the weather is bad tomorrow, we'll stay in and watch TV.

items.zh: ＿＿他生病了，所以今天没有来上课。
items.en: He's ill, so he didn't come to class today.

items.zh: ＿＿这件衣服很漂亮，但是太贵了。
items.en: This top is nice, but it's too expensive.
If you don't like it, don't buy it.

items.zh: ＿＿明天你有时间，就来我家吃饭吧。
items.en: If you're free tomorrow, come to my place for dinner.
I'm tired, but I still have to work.
There was a lot of traffic, so I was late.
If I were you, I wouldn't go.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: If it's too expensive, I won't buy it.
answers: 如果太贵，我就不买了。

items.en: If you're hungry, go ahead and eat first.
answers: 如果你饿了，就先吃吧。
你如果饿了，就先吃吧。
如果他来，我就走。
他如果来，我就走。

items.en: If you have any questions, ask the teacher.
answers: 如果有问题的话，就问老师。

items.en: If you practise more, you'll speak better.
answers: 如果你多练习，就会说得更好。
你如果多练习，就会说得更好。

items.en: If it isn't cold tomorrow, we'll go to the park.
answers: 如果明天不冷，我们就去公园。
明天如果不冷，我们就去公园。

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: If you don't go, I won't go.
answers: 如果你不去，我就不去。
你如果不去，我就不去。
如果你去，我就去。
你如果去，我就去。

items.zh: 如果你累了，我们休息就一下。
items.en: If you're tired, let's have a rest.
answers: 如果你累了，我们就休息一下。
你如果累了，我们就休息一下。

items.zh: 如果你不吃早饭，会就饿。
items.en: If you don't eat breakfast, you'll get hungry.
answers: 如果你不吃早饭，就会饿。
你如果不吃早饭，就会饿。
如果你不吃早饭，你就会饿。

items.zh: 我们就去爬山，如果明天天气好。
items.en: We'll go hiking if the weather is nice tomorrow.
answers: 如果明天天气好，我们就去爬山。
明天如果天气好，我们就去爬山。
